steps.tx: Triple-negative breast cancer lacks estrogen receptors, progesterone receptors, and HER2 overexpression. It exhibits an aggressive clinical course with an early propensity for visceral and central nervous system metastases. **KEYNOTE-522** established neoadjuvant pembrolizumab added to anthracycline, cyclophosphamide, and taxane-carboplatin chemotherapy. This regimen significantly increases pathological complete response and event-free survival, continuing adjuvant pembrolizumab for nine cycles.

steps.tx: Pathological complete response after neoadjuvant therapy serves as a robust surrogate endpoint for long-term survival. Residual invasive disease in surgical specimens confers a high risk of systemic relapse. In the landmark **CREATE-X** trial, adjuvant capecitabine for 6 to 8 cycles improves disease-free and overall survival in triple-negative breast cancer patients with residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

left.title: Pathological Complete Response (pCR)
points: No invasive disease in breast or nodes (ypT0/is ypN0)

right.title: Residual Invasive Disease (non-pCR)
points: Persistent tumour cells in breast or axilla
High rate of early distant recurrence
Consider adjuvant olaparib if germline BRCA

steps.tx: Antibody-drug conjugates have revolutionized treatment options in refractory advanced disease. **Sacituzumab govitecan** is an anti-Trop-2 antibody-drug conjugate providing significant PFS and OS benefit over single-agent chemotherapy in pretreated metastatic TNBC in the ASCENT trial. It couples a humanized trophoblast cell-surface antigen 2 monoclonal antibody to SN-38 via a hydrolysable linker, delivering high intratumoural topoisomerase I inhibitor concentrations.

steps.tx: In advanced disease, predictive biomarker evaluation guides first-line systemic selection. In **KEYNOTE-355**, first-line pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy significantly improves progression-free and overall survival in metastatic TNBC with PD-L1 combined positive score CPS 10 or higher. Chemotherapy partners include nab-paclitaxel, solvent-based paclitaxel, or gemcitabine plus carboplatin. Tumours with CPS under 10 receive cytotoxic chemotherapy alone.

steps.tx: Germline genetic alterations exploit synthetic lethality mechanisms in DNA repair-deficient malignancies. **PARP inhibitors** olaparib and talazoparib demonstrate superior progression-free survival compared to standard chemotherapy in metastatic HER2-negative breast cancer harbouring germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations. Pharmacological trapping of PARP at single-strand breaks generates catastrophic double-strand breaks during replication, selectively destroying homologous recombination-deficient tumour cells.

left.title: Homologous Recombination Competent
points: PARP inhibition blocks base excision repair

steps.tx: Chemotherapy intensification improves downstaging and pathological response rates. **Platinum agents** carboplatin or cisplatin increase pathological complete response rates when incorporated into neoadjuvant regimens for early-stage triple-negative breast cancer. In the GeparSixto and CALGB 40603 trials, carboplatin addition boosted pCR by ten to fifteen percent, particularly in tumours with homologous recombination deficiency or basal-like features.

steps.tx: Next-generation antibody-drug conjugates broaden therapeutic options beyond conventional cytotoxics. **Datopotamab deruxtecan** is a TROP2-directed ADC demonstrating clinically meaningful activity in heavily pretreated inoperable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer. In the pivotal TROPION-Breast02 trial, datopotamab deruxtecan showed superior survival compared to investigator choice chemotherapy, featuring an optimized plasma-stable linker and potent topoisomerase I payload.

steps.tx: Molecular heterogeneity explains differing chemotherapy sensitivities among clinical triple-negative cases. **Triple-negative breast cancer** comprises diverse transcriptomic subtypes including basal-like 1, basal-like 2, mesenchymal, and luminal androgen receptor LAR phenotypes. Basal-like 1 tumours are highly proliferative and DNA repair-deficient, showing the greatest chemotherapy sensitivity, whereas luminal androgen receptor tumours respond poorly to standard cytotoxics and may respond to anti-androgens.
